# Pipeline Artists

> > Pipeline Artists empowers authentic voices in film and publishing through education, competitions, talent discovery, and community engagement.

Pipeline Artists is a comprehensive platform for screenwriters, authors, and filmmakers offering competitions (Script Pipeline, Book Pipeline, Film Pipeline), a talent scout discovery platform, educational content through articles and podcasts, and year-round industry symposiums. The site features interviews with working professionals, craft advice, film criticism, and a vibrant community connecting emerging and established artists.

## Key Topics

- screenwriting
- film criticism
- script development
- writing craft
- filmmaking
- storytelling
- screenwriter interviews
- Script Pipeline
- Book Pipeline
- Film Pipeline
- entertainment industry
- creative collaboration
- artist resources
- Hollywood
- indie publishing

## Core Platforms

- [Pipeline Artists](https://pipelineartists.com): Homepage: education and empowerment for authentic voices in film and publishing.
- [Compete](https://pipelineartists.com/compete): Script Pipeline, Book Pipeline, and Film Pipeline competitions and submission platform for writers.
- [Pipeline: Scout](https://scout.pipelineartists.com): Talent discovery platform for writers, scripts, and book submissions.
- [Symposium](https://symposium.pipelineartists.com): Year-round conference in the arts with live panels, streaming events, and industry professionals.

## Content & Community

- [Read](https://pipelineartists.com/read): Articles and interviews covering unique perspectives across screenwriting, filmmaking, and the arts.
- [Listen](https://pipelineartists.com/listen): Original and curated podcasts hosted by artists and industry professionals in creative fields.
- [Socialize](https://pipelineartists.com/socialize): Social media community links on Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook for screenwriters.

## Screenwriting Craft & Analysis

- [The Most Undervalued Screenwriting Skill](https://pipelineartists.com/the-most-undervalued-screenwriting-skill): Screenwriting tips on page count management, formatting, and space efficiency in scripts.
- [Am I the Drama? Why Writers Should Take Acting Classes](https://pipelineartists.com/am-i-the-drama-why-writers-should-take-acting-classes): Writing craft advice on dialogue improvement through acting classes and improv techniques.
- [The Producer Vibe Check](https://pipelineartists.com/the-film-producer-vibe-check): Screenwriting advice on vetting producers and evaluating potential script collaborations.
- ['Love Actually' is a Great Film ... That I'd Hate to Read](https://pipelineartists.com/love-actually-is-a-great-film-that-id-hate-to-read): Screenplay analysis of ensemble writing and character development in Love Actually.

## Film Criticism & Analysis

- [The Biggest Thing Missing from Films Today](https://pipelineartists.com/the-biggest-thing-missing-from-films-today): Film criticism exploring pacing, editing style, and storytelling techniques in modern cinema.
- [The Brain on Dallas Buyers Club](https://pipelineartists.com/the-brain-on-dallas-buyers-club): Film analysis of Dallas Buyers Club exploring narrative power and post-partisan storytelling.

## Industry Interviews & Profiles

- [Writer Eric Anthony Glover on Sci-Fi, Superman and Joining Starfleet Academy](https://pipelineartists.com/writer-eric-anthony-glover-on-the-sci-fi-superman-and-joining-starfleet-academy): Interview with Eric Anthony Glover on Star Trek, Starfleet Academy, and sci-fi writing craft.
- ['Untitled In-Depth Interview Dramedy' with Screenwriters Joshua Paul Johnson and Jamie Napoli](https://pipelineartists.com/untitled-interview-with-josh-paul-johnson-and-jamie-napoli): Interview with Script Pipeline winners on home invasion romance and screenwriting process.
- [Contributors](https://pipelineartists.com/contributors): Staff profiles and editorial team including Jeanne Veillette Bowerman and Pipeline Media Group.

## Resources & Guidelines

- [Submission Guidelines](https://pipelineartists.com/submission-guidelines): Guidelines for submitting content pitches, articles, stories, and poetry to Pipeline Artists.
- [Dear Max: Writer Remedy](https://pipelineartists.com/dear-max-writer-remedy): Advice column from Maxine Perkins on publishing industry, Big 5 houses, and author resources.

## Optional

- [#MeToo 2](https://pipelineartists.com/metoo-2): Commentary on sexual assault, workplace abuse, and accountability in Hollywood.
- [Movies: The Best Deal in America](https://pipelineartists.com/movies-the-best-deal-in-america): Cultural commentary on cinema economics and entertainment value for families.
